brief: Sales kick-off in or near Munich for 120 people, 1 night, arriving 2027-01-20. We need a plenary room plus 4 breakout rooms for the regional sessions. Budget EUR 70,000 all in.

input.query: Munich conference hotel plenary breakout rooms

input.summary: Three Munich-area venues are open on 2027-01-20 and all quote under the EUR 70,000 budget (EUR 55,200 to 59,680, including estimated group travel from Berlin). All three need budget-owner sign-off because they are over EUR 20,000, plus expert review before any vendor contact. No dietary needs were given, so the RFP asks venues to confirm vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free options.

offers.tradeOff: Cheapest and has 5 breakout rooms, but its hotel has exactly 120 rooms (no spare) and it is a livelier party-style venue.
policyNotes: Expert review before any vendor contact

offers.tradeOff: Purpose-built for sales kick-offs with a 250-seat plenary, 8 breakouts and spare rooms, for about EUR 2,760 more than the cheapest.
policyNotes: Expert review before any vendor contact

offers.tradeOff: Quiet foothills setting with mountain views, but the most expensive, a 5-hour train ride, and only 4 breakouts and 130 rooms (little headroom).
policyNotes: Expert review before any vendor contact

rfp.subject: RFP: Sales kick-off, 120 guests, 1 night from 2027-01-20
rfp.body:
Hello,

Demo Co. is planning a sales kick-off and would like a proposal.

Arrival: 2027-01-20, 1 night (departure 2027-01-21)
Guests: 120
Room nights: 120 single-occupancy bedrooms x 1 night
Meeting space: 1 plenary room for 120 and 4 breakout rooms for regional sessions
Catering: day delegate package with lunch and coffee. Dietary needs: no counts given yet. Please confirm vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free options.
Accessibility: 0 wheelchair users. Step-free access is preferred.
Budget: all-in budget of EUR 70,000 for the event, including group travel from Berlin.

Please send availability, an itemised price and your terms by 2026-10-25.

Thank you,
Demo Co. Events
